developmentFindings.finding: V5 changes added columns, enum representations, independent history and indexes.
developmentFindings.resolution: Preserve every old non-status cell explicitly in upgrade assertions; validate new columns separately, native enum order/defaults/indexes and full SQL-vs-JPA metadata without modifying V1-V4/frozen fixtures.

developmentFindings.finding: User deletion guard initially selected id from joined UserChargeAssignment subtype.
developmentFindings.resolution: Select its deployed charge_assignment_id primary key; real successful pending deletion exercises every guard.

developmentFindings.finding: Historical Event exports were blocked by a guard over all retained registration references.
developmentFindings.resolution: Keep live/orphan references restrictive; allow resource deletion only after Event has an immutable deletion snapshot. Existing CSV/PDF post-event tests continue to preserve names and capacity.

developmentFindings.finding: Bulk deletion of RolePermissions left managed child references to the removed Role.
developmentFindings.resolution: Remove managed associations and flush before deleting Role; verify independent permission snapshot and unchanged permission catalog.

developmentFindings.finding: The three new history endpoints initially omitted explicit successful OpenAPI responses.
developmentFindings.resolution: Declare200 application/json with distinct immutable response-model names; validate generated OpenAPI for all three.

developmentFindings.finding: Two-state fixture data and raw Registry SQL still used legacy statuses.
developmentFindings.resolution: Exercise all three states with distinct synthetic values and archived timestamps; update current-state contracts to INACTIVE. Raw legacy values remain covered by migration tests.

reviewDecisions: Physical User deletion is conservatively limited to pending/unprovisioned credentials with no retained references or Session facts; complementary profiles also block it.
Runtime deletion of an assigned Role conflicts; archive revokes operational permission while retaining bindings.
ChargeDefinition ARCHIVED remains terminal under existing financial policy.
Old SOFT_DELETED Vehicles remain hidden and cannot be restored; preserved legacy flag does not authorize resurrection.
SystemLog keeps its existing technical retention; a broad PII-retention policy is outside this ticket.
Maintain Registry issuance/import flags off until homologation, initial range, historical import and future infrastructure review.
